summary_en: 60,000 shares (0.49% of S/O ex-treasury), ¥87.54M upper limit. ToSTNeT-3 block trade at ¥1,459/share on 7 Aug 2026 08:45 JST. Shares to be allocated to J-ESOP employee stock purchase trust for future grants.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares through off-floor trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, Howa Machinery's board authorized acquisition of up to 60,000 shares (0.49% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at a total cost not to exceed ¥87.54M. The shares will be purchased via a single off-floor block trade (ToSTNeT-3) on 7 August 2026 at 08:45 JST at ¥1,459 per share (the prior day's closing price). The purchased shares are designated for allocation to the company's J-ESOP (employee stock purchase trust) to fund future grants and distributions to participating employees. The acquisition is part of flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. Results will be published immediately after the trading session concludes.
